descriptions.zh: 在[planet.GetName]上持续的轰炸已经摧毁了我们对生命树网络的链接。
descriptions.en: The ongoing bombardment of [planet.GetName] has destroyed our network of life-giving Trees.

label.zh: 真不幸。

descriptions.zh: 在清理[from.GetName]上的残骸时，我们发现了可以追溯到我们前帝国时期的技术储藏。只需要进行少量的研究工作就可以将此知识重新整合进我们的技术体系中。
descriptions.en: While clearing wreckage on [from.GetName] we discovered an ancient cache of technology which dates back to our former empire. Only a minimal amount of research should be required to reintegrate this knowledge into our technology base.

label.zh: 棒极了。

descriptions.zh: [planet.GetName]曾经是[owner.GetName]的一处重要殖民地，它的一些残存基础设施仍然可作为重新殖民行星的基础。
descriptions.en: [planet.GetName] was once an important colony of the [owner.GetName], and some remnants of its infrastructure remain usable as a base to re-colonize the planet.

label.zh: 棒极了。

descriptions.zh:
难以置信的事情发生了。我们的首都已落入卑鄙的[From.GetName]的[From.species.GetHandNamePlural]手中。在最近[Root.GetName]的绝望的防御战中，我们的先祖落入了令人憎恶的入侵者的受众，并带走了许多[From.GetSpeciesAdj]。

为了以防万一，我们深思熟虑的先祖已经在诸多子嗣中安排好了继位者。这位备选继位者能够稳定我们蜂巢意识的一部分，但重新管控整个意识的复杂性和压力超出其能力范畴。在敌人趁我们陷入短暂的混乱而获取更大优势之前，我们必须尽快催熟这位子嗣，使其成为新的一位先祖。
descriptions.en:
The unimaginable has happened. Our capital has fallen into the [From.species.GetHandNamePlural] of the despicable [From.GetName]. During the last desperate defense of [Root.GetName], our Progenitor fell to the horrid invaders, taking many of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] with them.

In case of the unthinkable, our ever-calculating Progenitor had designated a successor among the Offspring. The Progenitor-in-waiting has managed to stabilize parts of our consciousness, but the complexity and pressure are too great for it to fully take up the mantle. We will have to incubate this Offspring and have it take over as a new Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of our momentary disunity.

label.zh: 我们必将重振雄风。

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]遭到了可怖的§Y[From.GetAdj]§!巨像武器的打击。我们失去的不仅仅是这个星球，还有我们的始祖以及所有居住在这个[Root.GetPlanetHabitat]上的子嗣。[Root.GetName]上的每一个子嗣和子个体都集结在一起，尽全力保护我们的始祖不受这个可怕武器的攻击。最终，它们的所有努力都只不过是延缓了无可避免的厄运，始祖很快陨落了。

现在我们的主体意识里满是矛盾碰撞的思想和冲动。如果我们不马上指派一名新的始祖，[Owner.GetName]很快就会停止生命。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has been struck with a Colossus weapon from the dreaded §Y[From.GetAdj]§!. We lost not only the world but also our Progenitor, and all Offspring residing on the [Root.GetPlanetHabitat]. Every drone and Offspring on [Root.GetName] had gathered in an effort to protect our Progenitor from the dreaded machine. In the end, their efforts did naught but prolong the inevitable, and the Progenitor fell soon after.

Now our consciousness is full of clashing thoughts and impulses. If we do not appoint a new Progenitor soon, then the [Owner.GetName] will cease to be.

label.zh: 我们要奋起反击！

descriptions.zh:
在持续数月的轰炸后，一切都结束了。[From.GetName]陷落了，一切生命的迹象都消失了。在厚厚的尘埃云在由我们前首都化作的废墟街道中翻腾。死亡的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曝尸荒野，在我们中最伟大的一员，我们的先祖的身边堆作尸山，而先祖也在最后的轰炸中随之而去。

我们现在不得不把所有的行政能力转移到[capital_scope.GetName]，并且需要建立新的始祖巢穴。在敌人开始利用我们暂时的分崩离析前，我们必须将其中一个子嗣孵化为新的始祖。
descriptions.en:
After many months of bombardment, it is over. [From.GetName] has fallen, all trace of life has been eradicated. Dust clouds billow across the ruined streets of our former capital. Dead [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]  litter the ground, culminating in an enormous pile of corpses surrounding the greatest of us all - our Progenitor, which finally fell during the final bombardment.

We now have to move our administration to [capital_scope.GetName], and it will be necessary to establish a new Progenitor Nest. We will have to incubate one of our Offspring to assume the role of Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of this moment of disunity.

label.zh: 我们必将重振雄风。

descriptions.zh: 我们终于获得了量子弹弓单阵列所在的恒星系及其周边区域。现在我们可以送工程师过去以开始修复工程，这样就能让这个休眠的结构重获新生。
descriptions.en: We have finally secured the system and region around the broken Quantum Catapult Single Array. Now at last, we can send engineers in to start the repair work necessary to bring this dormant structure back to life.

label.zh: 万里长征第一步。

descriptions.zh:
在蓝图和图示之中我们恢复了一份奇怪的文档：

这是来自量子建筑师的个人文件

鸿蒙之初，我们居于黑暗。上帝说：“要有黑暗”，于是世界充满了黑暗。当我们最初的祖先获得了知觉之光，我们就想在天空中搜寻生命的迹象和意义，但我们的头顶只有无际的黑暗。随着我们建立了文明，我们的思想扫过黑夜中的每一片阴影，我们在建立第一座城市的地方辛勤劳作，经常测试它们的地基。

数千年后，我突然莽撞地向“上”看了一眼。当其他人还面朝大地而劳作时，我的思绪却向天空打开。我建造了电路和钢铁的神殿，用我的智慧之光制作了我自己的工具。通过完善二极管和电容器的迷宫，我将我的意识传播到整个宇宙，感知笼罩在我们世界的黑暗之外的一切事物。

因为我能感受到其他人感受不到的东西：我们在宇宙并不孤独。通过玻璃般的黑暗，我能感受到数以千计的其他星球。我能感知到不可能。在我们无尽的黑夜之外是燎原般的万千星点。
descriptions.en:
Among blueprints and schematics, we recovered a strange document:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

In the beginning, we dwelled in darkness. Our gods said, 'let there be dark,' and there was. When our first ancestors gained the spark of sentience, we searched the heavens for signs of life or meaning, but all above us was darkness. As we built our civilization, our minds scanned for shadows in the night. We toiled in the places where we built our first cities, always testing their foundations.

Thousands of years later, I had the temerity to look *up*.While others labored with their gaze downcast, my mind opened up to the heavens. Building a temple of circuitry and steel, I formed my own tools, empowered by the light of my intellect. Perfecting a labyrinth of diodes and capacitors, I cast my consciousness through the cosmos, perceiving something beyond the dark skies that shrouded our world.

For I could sense what others could not: We were not alone in the universe. As though through a glass darkly, I could detect thousands of other worlds. I could sense the impossible. Beyond the night burned a thousand points of light.

label.zh: 恢复更多的文件。

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们的探险队还在筛选能够解码该巨型结构的建造计划的数据，他们已经发现了另一个看起来像是宗教文本的摘录：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我吐露真相，而我的人民却回以混乱。
我们每个人都在自己思想和情感的迷雾中麻木劳作。我们试探性地对他人伸出手，但我们中有太多人是孤独的。我们的神在黑暗中创造了世界，我们被告知说我们才是神的造物的中心。

就因为我胆敢梦想天外的世界，我的愿景就被他人认为是谎言。我们当中的其他人问：怎么才能证明这些梦？我们怎么能相信我们不能证明的事？作为回应，我将那些还愿意听我的人引到自己的实验室。这些最聪明的头脑可以感知到我所能感知到的：夜幕之外的其他星球。

而最黑暗的头脑却报之以其他的回应，他们捏造新的论点，紧握致命的武器。那些危险的头脑吟唱寓言，说我们的星球会陷入动荡，因为我们不再是神的宠儿。然而我还是知道真相：创造之光是一幅巨大的帷幕。查宇宙之秘，我被欣喜的浪潮所裹挟，渐渐失去了自己的身份。
descriptions.en:
While our expedition keeps sifting through the data to decode the megastructure's plans, they have found another excerpt of what looks like a religous text:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

I spoke the truth, and my people answered with chaos.
Each of us labors in our own fog of thoughts and emotions. We tentatively reach out to others, yet so many of us are alone. Our gods crafted the world from darkness, we are told, and we were allegedly the centerpiece of their creation.

Because I dared to dream of worlds beyond, I was told my vision was a lie. Who among us, others asked, could confirm these dreams? How can we believe, they said, what we cannot prove? And in response, I led those who would listen to my laboratory. The brightest minds could perceive a reflection of what I experienced: other worlds beyond the veil of night.

The darkest minds crafted other responses, formed new arguments, clutched deadly weapons. Dangerous minds sang that our world would be in turmoil, for we were no longer the favored spawn of the gods. Yet I knew the truth: Creation's illumination was a vast tapestry. Contemplating the majesty of the cosmos, I was swept away in tides of rapture, losing my identity.

label.zh: 有意思。

descriptions.zh:
更多类弥赛亚的文本被恢复：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我不断地被无边无垠的宇宙所折磨和诱惑，开始考虑去遥远的世界并亲自体验。生活在被无尽黑夜包裹的世界中，其他的头脑做着美梦，而我寻求于他们进行交流。在黑暗之外有光明指引着我，光明诱惑着我，给予了我无限的启示。因此我把我的思想广播到遥远而未知的世界……

天上如是，地上亦然。我对天空的愿景带给了我喜悦，在地上，我同样找到了给我同样的解脱的幸福的人。我与另一个科学家坠入爱河，那是一位有远见的人，用其他的办法在群星中寻求我所感知到的世界。

我们并不只是分享各自所见。我们立誓成为对方终生的伴侣。随着工作的进展，我们依偎在每一个漫漫长夜。我的伴侣梦到了星舰的设计图，在蜡制设计版中刻出原始的太阳能航空器。我不断用电路修修补补，努力将我的思想和无限融合起来。我的冒险越是深入，我内心的欣喜就越是充盈。多么美妙啊！永无止境的欢愉！
descriptions.en:
More of the quasi messianic figure's writings have been recovered:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

Tormented and tantalized by a boundless cosmos, I contemplated the means to travel to distant worlds and experience them firsthand. Enshrouded beyond the endless night, other minds dreamed, and I sought communion with them. Beyond a great darkness, a great Light led me on, offering me temptations and endless revelations. And thus I cast my mind out further into the unknown...

As above, so below. My visions of the heavens brought me joy, but down below, I found someone who brought me the same liberation of happiness. I fell in love with another scientist, a visionary who spoke of other ways to seek the stars I had sensed in my reveries.

We did more than share a vision. We pledged ourselves as partners for life. And as our work progressed, we stayed up later each night. My partner dreamed designs for starships, etching crude solar-powered spacecraft on their wax design board. I tinkered with circuitry, straining to unify my mind with infinity. The farther I ventured, the more my rapture grew. Such bliss! The ecstasy of endless eternity!

label.zh: 恢复更多的文件。

descriptions.zh:
来自量子建筑师的个人文件，其身份为宇宙制船师的伴侣

我的伴侣十分耐心而我却有些莽撞。我的挚爱拥有科学和逻辑的智慧而我也有着驰骋的心际。随着我们漫漫长夜中愈行愈远，我徒劳地将自己的意识广播到虚空。我忽视了睡眠，忽视了饥饿，最终也忽视了我的挚爱。我们在宇宙中追寻梦想的同时，内心却开始出现了鸿沟。

我的挚爱为这种现象创造了一个词：量子纠缠。我的身体还在这儿，但思想却驰骛天外，竭力地探寻欣喜和与永恒的交流。我的伴侣跟我说其他话，但我丝毫听不进去。“吾爱”，我的伴侣说，“回到我的身边”，但我却只能听到恒星的回声。

很快就到了测试我伴侣的太阳能星舰的时候。我志愿驾驶这架飞船。当我第一次掌舵并开始处女航之时，我将梦到通往遥远海岸的航线，我的身还在原处，心已神游天外。

我的挚爱渐渐平静下来，我会赐予我的挚爱无限，通往永恒，来吾道夫先路。我会给予我的挚爱万千世界之梦。
descriptions.en:
From the personal files of the Quantum Architect, partner of the Cosmic Shipwright

My partner was patient, and I was reckless. My Beloved had science and logic, and I had my psychic reveries. Longer and longer into the night, I vainly attempted to cast my consciousness into the void. I neglected sleep. I neglected food. I neglected My Beloved. As we pursued our dreams of venturing into the cosmos, a gulf grew between us.

My Beloved found words for our phenomenon: quantum entanglement. My body was here, but my mind was eons away, desperately seeking ecstasy and a communion with eternity. My partner told me other words, but I would not listen. 'My Love,' they said, 'come back to me,' but I could only hear the echoes of the stars.

Soon, the time will come to test my partner's solar starship. I have volunteered sit at the controls. As I sit at the helm of its first test flight, I will dream of a course to distant shores, my mind *here* and my body *there*.

My Beloved has grown quiet, but I will gift them with infinity, blazing a trail to eternity. I will offer them the dreams of a thousand worlds.

label.zh: 很迷人。

descriptions.zh:
来自宇宙制船师的个人文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们的第一艘星舰一年前就消失了。我们至今不知道之前到底发生了什么。我的伴侣，量子建筑师，他只留下了遗产和谜团。我们所能做的最深入的推测也不过是我的挚爱最终成为了宇宙中的一员。在他坐上控制面板之前开始处女航，他与无限融合在了一起，被对天空的狂喜和遐想所吞没。我们的测试船再也没有回来。

现在我只能用手头上粗糙的工具劳作，将我已经一片狼藉的工作和生活重拾起来。我更多的太阳能舰船开始了前往永夜的旅途。我开始着手安装更好的引擎，原型引擎能够让我们的舰船穿越超空间。在某些夜晚，我梦想着有一种技术可以将我们送往未知的星系，就像我失去的伴侣的思想和灵魂那样。

我向光明伸出手臂，拒绝向黑暗屈服。我坐在我的挚爱的实验室中，就像现在那样阅读他们的日志并写下自己的日志。有时候当一切陷入至暗，我尝试着把我的思想广播向宇宙。这是无限的信标。
descriptions.en:
From the personal files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

Our first starship vanished a year ago. We still do not know precisely what happened. My partner, the Quantum Architect, has left behind a legacy and a mystery. As far as we can derive, My Love finally became one with the cosmos. Sitting at the controls aboard our first test flight, they merged with infinity, overwhelmed by rapturous psychic contemplation of the heavens. Our test ship never returned.

Now I labor with my own crude tools, left to reforge my work and my life from the wreckage. More of my solar starships have begun their journeys into the Great Night. I have begun work on better engines, prototypes that can propel our vessels through hyperspace. And on some nights, I dream of a technology that can leap for the stars like the mind and soul of my lost partner, launching us into the unknown.

As I reach for the light, I refuse to succumb to the darkness. I sit in My Love's laboratory, just as I am now, reading their journals and writing my own. And sometimes, when all is darkest, I attempt to cast my own mind across the cosmos. Infinity beckons.

label.zh: 恢复更多的文件。

descriptions.zh:
随着我们终于找到了该结构建造计划的缺失文件，我们还原了最后的文本：

来自宇宙制船师的文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们探寻了许多方法以实现我的挚爱的创新，也就是他们的量子创造。我不知道我们是否可以沿着这条看似莽撞的道路，以量子建筑师的设计为蓝本，以缓慢的步伐抵达群星。我寻求能跨越超空间的浪潮，思考着能将我们带到遥远彼岸的流向。

我的舰船沿着缓慢的路线前进，在深夜中我读着我的挚爱的日志，努力理解其中的数学表达式和相关机理。当我的思想触及无限时，我意识到我的挚爱还在那儿。他引导了先路，我必须跟着前行。

通过失去我却反而获得了灵感。我们曾开始制造过一个伟大的机械，它能够推动我们的舰船跨越星系，就如同我的挚爱跨入无限那样。当我离开时，我谦逊地要求这台宇宙设备以及其迭代更新产物应该纳入量子建筑师的个人日志。当其他人读到这篇日志时，毫无疑问我的灵魂已经飞往远方。我会找到在无垠的宇宙中和我的挚爱团聚的道路。因为我知道我们将共同居住在永恒中，梦想并漂流在万千星点之中。
descriptions.en:
As we finally found the missing pieces for the structure plans, we also recovered one last text:

From the files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

We have searched for ways to employ My Love's innovations, their quantum creations. I am left wondering if we can take that same reckless path, empowered by the Quantum Architect's designs, but I reach for the stars at a slower pace. I search for a wave to ride through hyperspace, contemplating a current that will take us to distant shores.

My ships take the slow route, but late at night, I read My Love's journals, struggling to tame their mathematics and machinations. As my mind reaches out towards eternity, I know in my heart that My Love is still out there. They blazed a trail towards heaven, and I must follow.

Through loss, I have found inspiration. We have begun work on a grand machine that will propel our ships across the galaxy, just as My Beloved leapt into infinity. And someday, I will do what they have done. When I am gone, I humbly request that this cosmic device and all its iterations should include the personal logs of the Quantum Architect. Doubtless by the time others read this, my soul will have taken taken flight. I will have found a way to join My Beloved out there in the vast expanse. For I know that we will dwell in eternity together, dreaming and drifting through a thousand points of light.

label.zh: 无限信标。

descriptions.zh:
学生们，我们在梦中曾指引你们。通过这些梦境我们塑造了你们的世界。如今你们已茁壮成长，可以将我们的信条传播于星际，你们真正的试炼正刚刚开始。你们的勤勉将光耀虚境，你们的辛劳成果亦是对你们教导的兑现。为了点燃事业之火，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。

如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
descriptions.en:
Students, in dreams we have guided you. Through visions, we have shaped your world. Now that you stand ready to export our doctrine to the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. Through your work shall the Shroud be honored. The profits of your labor shall fulfill the promise of our teachings. To stoke the fires of industry, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.

In times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

descriptions.zh:
我们的学生啊，我们已经教导了你们一代又一代，将虚境和它的奥秘的知识播撒入你们的梦境之中。现在你们已经能够触及星辰，你们真正的学徒生涯才刚刚开始。前路不会一马平川。为了照亮你们前行的道路，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。

如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
descriptions.en:
Our students, for generations we have taught you, seeding our knowledge of the Shroud and its mysteries within your dreams. Now that you have reached the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. The path forward will not be an easy one. To light the way, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.

In times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

label.zh: 我们心怀感激地接受你们的馈赠。
label.en: We receive your gift with gratitude.

descriptions.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。通过早就铺设好的隧道，你们的到来已经被虚境所感知。你们的回声仍在颤抖、涟漪般回荡过潜意识的水面。虚境神秘中的居者一定会祝福我们的会面。在这里你们是最受欢迎的存在。
descriptions.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Through the Tunnel long prepared, your passage has been felt by the Shroud itself. The echoes yet shiver, rippling through the waters of the unconscious mind. Those who dwell within the mysteries of the Shroud have surely blessed our meeting. You are most welcome here.

descriptions.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。迹象和预兆都预示了这一刻，虚境本身也会见证你们的到来。我们已经期待了很久，只为与你们在感知之境相会。在这里你们是欢迎之至的存在。
descriptions.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Signs and portents foretold this moment, and the Shroud itself has witnessed your passage. Long have we waited to meet with you in the realm of the senses. You are most welcome here.

label.zh: 棒极了。

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其诞生的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。从这个星系开始的旅途将会更快……也远远地更为神秘。
descriptions.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars. Journeys from this system will now be faster... and infinitely more mysterious.

descriptions.zh:
在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其召唤出的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。

还剩下一步：我们导师所居住的那一侧边界至今对我们封闭。地图中实际上的航道对虚境来说可能无关紧要，但是在这边的星球还是非常麻烦。至少现在，我们通过隧道的路径还是被封锁着。
descriptions.en:
After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars.

Only one step remains: the border beyond which our Teachers reside is closed to us. Lines on a map may be immaterial to the Shroud, but in this world they remain troublesome. For now, our passage through the Tunnel remains blocked.

label.zh: 愿虚境欢迎我们的到来。
label.en: May the Shroud welcome our passage.

label.zh: 明白了。

descriptions.zh:
欢迎你们，新外星人朋友们！

由于你们选择成为我们的……盟友，我们认为现在正是与你们联络的时候。你们选择了理性而不是逼迫我们使用暴力，这令我们非常愉快。
descriptions.en:
Welcome, dear newfound allies!

We felt it was only right to contact you now that you have chosen to partake in our... alliance. It pleases us you chose to see reason, rather than forcing our hand towards violence.

label.zh: 是你们让我们别无选择的不是么？
label.en: You didn't give us much of a choice, did you?

label.zh: 还有什么别的你们想告诉我们的吗？
label.en: Was there something you wanted to talk to us about?

label.zh: 我们以成为你们的一员而骄傲！
label.en: We are proud to be a part of your alliance!

descriptions.zh:
哼哼……无论如何！

经过深思熟虑，我们决定投资一大笔资源来援助你们的国家进行特化。在未来，这将让你们的帝国在我们所有的伙伴和盟友中扮演更加重要的角色。

我们还不太确定你们的人民更喜欢怎么样的角色，军事化？专精学术？或你们更感兴趣矿物和物质财富？
descriptions.en:
Hum hum... In any case!

After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.

We were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?

descriptions.zh:
我们同样骄傲于你们的到来！

经过深思熟虑，我们决定投资一大笔资源来援助你们的国家进行特化。在未来，这将让你们的帝国在我们所有的伙伴和盟友中扮演更加重要的角色。

我们还不太确定你们的人民更喜欢怎么样的角色，军事化？专精学术？或你们更感兴趣矿物和物质财富？
descriptions.en:
And we are proud to welcome you!

After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.

We were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?

descriptions.zh: 那么……你有重新考虑吗？
descriptions.en: So... Have you given it a second thought?

label.zh: 军事专精听起来棒极了。

label.en: Could you tell us more about Bulwarks?

label.en: Our people are more scholarly in nature.

label.zh: 我们更喜欢物质财富和矿物专精的特化。
label.en: We would like a material and mineral focused specialization.

label.zh: 能不能再详细介绍一下勘探邦？
label.en: Could you tell us more about Prospectoria?

descriptions.zh:
一种趋于暴力的倾向，是这样吗？

我们通常所说的戍邦是一种致力于军事事务的国家。这意味着我们会按月度支援你们一些基础的矿物和食物，这样你们国家可以将更多的精力放在战争上。

作为回报，我们希望你们可以为我们抵御外辱，在我们联盟的边境上扮演重要角色。这么说你们觉得可以接受吗？
descriptions.en:
A tendency towards violence, is that it?

A Bulwark, as we usually refer to them, are empires specialized in military affairs. It means we would support you with some basic minerals and food on a monthly basis so you could set aside a larger part of your empire to focus on war.

In turn, we expect you to help us defend against external threats, and play an important role at the borders of our allied space. Does that sound agreeable to you?

label.zh: 听起来是我们可以接受的。
label.en: That sounds like something we could live with.

options.script:
name = origin.5706.a
default_hide_option = yes
origin_imperial_fiefdom_bulwark_specialization_effect = yes

label.zh: 我们需要再考虑考虑。

descriptions.zh:
所以这引起了你们的兴趣不是吗？

我们通常所说的学邦是一种专精于研究科技的国家。我们承诺保护你们的国家，而你们便可以集中资源让国家以及我们的盟友更加先进。

作为回报我们希望你们可以与我们其他国家分享所有令人惊奇的科学发现。这样的合约是否令你们满意？
descriptions.en:
So they have piqued your interest, have they?

A Scholarium, as they are known, is an empire specialized in science and research. We would pledge to protect your empire so you can focus most of your resources on advancing your empire and our allies alike.

In turn we expect you to share any peculiar peculiar technological breakthroughs you might have with the rest of us. Would that sort of contract work for you?

label.zh: 我们的人民乐于接受这项协定。
label.en: Our people would be happy with that deal.

options.script:
name = origin.5707.a
default_hide_option = yes
origin_imperial_fiefdom_scholarium_specialization_effect = yes

label.zh: 我们需要再考虑考虑。

descriptions.zh:
你们对这项协定感兴趣没错吧？

勘探邦，正如大众赋予其称呼，是一种专精于发现矿物、生产战略资源的国家——但这会以牺牲他们的科学发展能力为代价。通过合适的工具，一些勘探邦可以找到其他人容易忽略的稀有矿物，尽管这只是我们道听途说的。

这听起来对你们的人民而言是不是一项可以胜任的工作呢？
descriptions.en:
Interested in that deal, are you?

A Prospectorium, as many call them, is an empire which specializes in finding minerals, and manufacturing strategic resources - but often at the cost of advancing their empire scientifically. With the right tools, some of the Prospectoria have been able to locate rare minerals that others overlook, though that's only a rumor we have heard.

Does that sound like something your people would be able to do?

label.zh: 我认为这非常适合我们。
label.en: We believe that is something that would fit us.

descriptions.zh:
紧随着[overlord_ruler.GetName]的突然驾崩，我们获悉了[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上正经历的混乱。不太受支持的[overlord_heir.GetName]通过军事手段将王座纳入了[overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself]的囊中，令[overlord_heir.GetHisHer]的皇亲和[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上的人民们大为不满。

在[overlord_heir.GetFirstName]的引起骚乱的崛起之后，许多人开始质疑[Root.Overlord.GetName]统治我们的合法性。如果他们连自己首都的安全都无法保证，他们还有什么能耐来保护我们的安全？
descriptions.en:
We have received news about the ongoing chaos on [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName], following the sudden death of [overlord_ruler.GetName]. The unpopular [overlord_heir.GetName] has taken the throne for [overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself] with the help of the military, much to the chagrin of [overlord_heir.GetHisHer] siblings and the people of [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName].

After the troublesome rise of [overlord_heir.GetFirstName], many have started questioning the right of the [Root.Overlord.GetName] to dominion over us. If they cannot keep their own capital peaceful, what hope do they possibly have to keep the rest of us safe?

label.zh: 哪怕是天上的长堤，也是溃于蚁穴。
label.en: A starfish rots from the head down.

options.script: name = origin.5725.a

descriptions.zh:
失去了能够维持团结统一的伟大领袖，[previous_overlord.GetName]现已分崩离析，而每一部分都宣称自己才是原先帝国的正统。然而由于没有足够的实力和合法性，他们对所有附庸的控制也随之瓦解。

在每一个分裂的部分都在互相征伐，争夺[previous_overlord.GetName]的王位时，他们原先的附属国们也可以按自己的意愿行事了。
descriptions.en:
With no great leader to hold them together, the [previous_overlord.GetName] has dissolved into several parts, with each claiming their right to rule over the old empire. Without the strength or legitimacy of old however, their hold over all their vassals has crumbled to nothing.

With the disparate parts of the old empire fighting over the throne of the [previous_overlord.GetName], their old subjects are now free to do as they wish.

label.zh: 重获自由喽。

tooltips.zh: 我们独立了。
tooltips.en: We become independent.

label.zh: 是时候有新的领袖登上历史舞台了。
label.en: It is time for a new leader to take charge.

tooltips.zh: 我们独立了。
tooltips.en: We become independent.

tooltips.zh: 对§Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§!和它原先的所有附属国获得§Y30年§!的§Y征服§!宣战理由。
tooltips.en: Gain a §YSubjugation§! Casus Belli against the §Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§! and all its old vassals for §Y30 years§!.

label.zh: 我们忠于王座，无论如何。
label.en: We are loyal to the throne - no matter what.

tooltips.zh: 我们将继续是§Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§!的忠诚附属国。
tooltips.en: Remain a loyal subject of the §Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]的人民对他们国土以外的事情漠不关心，不过他们清楚，无论外界发生了什么都可能会破坏他们一心一意的内部专注。因此他们向我们寻求如同原先[previous_overlord.GetName]所给予的类似的保护。
descriptions.en: The people of the [new_subject_target.GetName] care little for anything outside their own borders, but they are aware that whatever is out there might ruin their single-minded internal focus. Therefore they have turned to us for protection of the same kind the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

label.zh: 这对我们的帝国颇有裨益。
label.en: They will be a boon to our empire.

label.en: We have no interest in these scientists.

descriptions.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]因其众多争执不休的王子们而臭名昭著，他们一直处心积虑想争取到每一点可以争取的影响力和权力。仅这一次他们似乎终于成功取得了一项共识，向我们派出了特使以期缔结新的外交条约。似乎他们开始怀念曾经[previous_overlord.GetName]给予的那种悉心呵护了。
descriptions.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] is known for their many quarreling princes, all desperately trying to grab hold of whatever influence and power they can. For once it seems they have finally managed to agree to something, and have sent envoys looking to make a new diplomatic pact with us. It seems they are missing the protection the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

label.zh: 行吧，至少他们能有点共识。
label.en: As long as they can agree to something.

			resource = influence
			value = @tier1influencereward
			min = @tier1influencemin
			max = @tier1influencemax
		}

label.zh: 我们对这群呱噪的家伙可没有半点兴趣。
label.en: We are not interested in their quarrels.

descriptions.zh: 在[previous_overlord.GetName]崩溃之前，[new_subject_target.GetName]与之颇为相近，似乎他们有兴趣与我们建立发展相似的关系。他们的外交官正在连夜撰写一份能令双方都满意签署的外交协定，作为我们两个帝国相互之间建立起更加充分的理解的第一步。
descriptions.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] was particularly close to [previous_overlord.GetName] before their dissolution, and it seems like they are interested in building a similar relationship to our empire moving forward. Now their diplomats are scrambling to finish a diplomatic deal both sides will be happy to sign, as the first step in building a better understanding between our two empires.

label.zh: 这儿会有他们的容身之所的。
label.en: We will find room for them.

label.zh: 请特使回去吧。

descriptions.zh: 似乎[new_subject_target.GetName]的市场在[previous_overlord.GetName]解体后，有些不稳定。现在他们已经没有人可以依靠了。几位贸易巨头已与我们接触，并表示愿意提供[new_subject_target.GetAdj]劳役，甚至非常愿意献上部分利润，一旦他们的帝国稳定下来。
descriptions.en: It seems the markets of the [new_subject_target.GetName] have been somewhat unstable after the dissolution of the [previous_overlord.GetName], now that they no longer have someone to rely on for protection. Several trade princes have approached us and offered to support [new_subject_target.GetAdj] servitude, and even part of the profits that are sure to follow as their empire stabilizes once more.

label.zh: 只要他们能乖乖交上能量币就行。
label.en: As long as they can bring their energy credits.

label.en: We have no need of their capital wealth.

descriptions.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

[fotd_Leader.GetName]是[fotd_Leader.GetSpecialization]专家，和[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的任何[Root.GetSpeciesName]享受同等权利。
descriptions.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

[fotd_Leader.GetName] is [fotd_Leader.GetSpecialization] specialist, equal to any [Root.GetSpeciesName] on [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

descriptions.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

我们的首席科学家同[fotd_Leader.GetName]保持了多年的联系，对[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]所作的工作赞不绝口。
descriptions.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Our lead scientists have been in communication with [fotd_Leader.GetName] for many years and are extremely impressed by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] work.

descriptions.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

尽管[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]被[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]在[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的同事称为[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上最后一位偏执狂科学家，但这样的论述并不够全面。
descriptions.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Although [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] has been described as the least paranoid scientist on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] colleagues on [owner.GetHomeWorldName], this isn't really saying much.

descriptions.zh:
一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。

[fotd_Leader.GetName]视自己为一名殉道者。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]前来我们“厄运笼罩的星球”，希望拯救我们的科技免受外部势力的摧毁。
descriptions.en:
A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

[fotd_Leader.GetName] styles themselves something of a martyr. In traveling to our "doomed world" [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] hope to preserve our technology from destruction by outside forces.

descriptions.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]向我们求助，因为[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上条件受限的设施阻碍了[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的研究。我们的科学家已经做了担保，保证这位潜在访客的一切行为都是良好的。
descriptions.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] reached out to us because the limited facilities on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] are stunting [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] research. Our scientists have vouched for our potential visitor's good behavior.

descriptions.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap]的研究已经被[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的政府定性为危险。他们的损失，是我们的收获。
descriptions.en: [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap] research has been classified as dangerous by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] government. Their loss is our gain.

descriptions.zh: 出于在学术上的杰出表现，[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]将获得[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的一个著名奖项。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]也同意在我们这里待上一段时间，就自己的研究举行一系列讲座。
descriptions.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] will be the recipient of a prestigious award on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] for academic excellence. [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] have also agreed to stay with us for a while, holding a series of lectures about their research.

descriptions.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]会研究当地的[GetStudyTopic]，并试图利用这些来改善[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上的生活。
descriptions.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] will be studying local [GetStudyTopic] in an attempt to improve life on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName].

label.zh: 只要你遵守这个社会的规范 ，那么你就会受到欢迎。
label.en: You are welcome as long as you abide by the norms of this society.

tooltips.zh: 将§Y[fotd_Leader.GetName]§!作为§H科学官§!添加到我们的§H可招募领袖§!。
tooltips.en: Add §Y[fotd_Leader.GetName]§! as a §HScientist§! to our §HRecruitable Leaders§!.

label.zh: 管好你自己。

descriptions.zh: 一位来自[fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName]的指挥官提出要加入我们的海军，担任临时指挥官。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]的动机尚不清楚，但我们的线人告诉我们，这可能牵涉到一起丑闻。
descriptions.en: A Commander from [fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName] is offering to join our navy as a temporary commander. [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] motivations are unclear, but our informants tell us that there might be a scandal involved.

descriptions.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetName]非常急迫地想和我们签署临时合同。[fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName]一直是滋生狡猾和非常规战术的温床。
descriptions.en: [fotd_Leader.GetName] is eager to sign on with us temporarily. [fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName] has always been a breeding ground for crafty and unconventional tactics.

descriptions.zh: 由于指挥官[fotd_Leader.GetName]在最近一次联合舰队演习上的出色表现，我们决定扩大此人的权限，让其指挥一支真正的海军舰队。
descriptions.en: After excelling in a recent joint fleet exercise, we have extended Commander [fotd_Leader.GetName] the opportunity to take command in a real navy.

descriptions.zh: 因涉嫌将[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]指挥的舰船置于过度危险之中而被暂时调离岗位，不服气的指挥官[fotd_Leader.GetName]请求加入我们的海军。尽管[fotd_Leader.GetName]名声在外，那些曾与[fotd_Leader.GetHerHim]一起服役的人仍然尊重[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的才能。
descriptions.en: Placed on temporary leave for allegedly putting the vessels under [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] command in excessive danger, Commander [fotd_Leader.GetName] has requested to join our navy. Despite [fotd_Leader.GetName]'s reputation, those who have served with [fotd_Leader.GetHerHim] still respect [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] talent.

label.zh: 只要你不叛逃。
label.en: As long as you don't go rogue.

tooltips.zh: 将§Y[fotd_Leader.GetName]§!作为§H指挥官§!添加到我们的§H可招募领袖§!。
tooltips.en: Add §Y[fotd_Leader.GetName]§! as an §HCommander§! to our §HRecruitable Leaders§!.

label.zh: 对于一根松动的鱼雷管来说，你也太胖了！
label.en: You are too much of a loose torpedo tube!

descriptions.zh:
在同我们一起生活了许多年之后，[fotd_Leader.GetName]决定返回家乡。一些政府官员反对这一变动，因为[fotd_Leader.GetName]已经成为我们高级领导层不可或缺的一部分。

[GetfotdCoercion]
descriptions.en:
After long years living among us, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has decided to return home. Some in government are opposed to the move, as [fotd_Leader.GetName] has become an integral part of our senior leadership.

[GetfotdCoercion]

label.zh: 我们会信守承诺。

tooltips.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetName]会返回[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]
tooltips.en: [fotd_Leader.GetName] will return to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName].

label.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价留住他们。
label.en: We need to keep them at any cost.

descriptions.zh: 最近，[fotd_Leader.GetName]的性格变得越来越孤僻。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]再次请求允许他回家。[fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap]的同事指出，[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]由于患上了抑郁症一直对他们的工作产生了负面影响，并建议我们批准[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]离开。
descriptions.en: Recently, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has grown increasingly withdrawn. Once again, [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] is requesting permission to return home. [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap] coworkers note that [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] depression has been affecting their work, and suggest we let [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] go.

label.zh: 我们会信守承诺。

tooltips.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetName]会返回[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]
tooltips.en: [fotd_Leader.GetName] will return to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName].

label.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价留住他们。
label.en: We need to keep them at any cost.

descriptions.zh: 在过去的几个周期里，人们看到[fotd_Leader.GetName]在喃喃自语，有时在大厅里踱步。今天，[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]没有来上班。我们的一架逃生飞船也报告失踪。这些事件不太可能是一个巧合。
descriptions.en: Over the last several cycles, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has been seen muttering to themselves and pacing the halls. Today, [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] failed to arrive at work. One of our escape shuttles has also been reported missing. It's unlikely these events are a coincidence.

label.zh: 真不幸。

tooltips.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetName]回到了[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]。
tooltips.en: [fotd_Leader.GetName] returned to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
似乎我们兄弟星球上的科学家已经在[root.fotdGetTech]领域取得了数个全新的、公认的、有见地的突破。尽管他们可以说是目光狭隘，但在这种情况下有一说一，他们的技术已经超过了我们自己取得的成就。

他们愿意与我们分享他们的见解，以换取我们[root.fotdGetTechPrice]——可以肯定的是，这个价格不菲。
descriptions.en:
It seems that the scientists on our partner planet have made several new, and admittedly insightful, breakthroughs into the field of [root.fotdGetTech]. Despite their parochial tendencies, it's fair to say that in this case their technology has outstripped our own achievements.

They are willing to share their insights with us in exchange for us [root.fotdGetTechPrice] - a steep price, to be sure.

label.zh: 好，我们会遵从。

tooltips.zh: 这会让我们§R10年§!内无法进入§Y虚境§!。
tooltips.en: This will prevent us from accessing §YThe Shroud§! for §R10 years§!.

label.zh: 派遣间谍。
他们疯了吗？我们绝无可能同意这个。
label.en: Are they mad? We would never agree to this.

options.script: name = origin.6015.c

descriptions.zh: 无论是出于工作疏忽、工作人员的无能，还是纯粹的不幸，§Y[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]§!现在深陷[root.GetSeperatistAid]供应危机。如果没有帮助，很可能数百万人将受灾。
descriptions.en: Whether due to negligence, incompetence, or sheer misfortune §Y[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]§! now struggle with their [root.GetSeperatistAid] supply. Without help it is very likely that millions will suffer.

label.zh: 我们需要帮助[fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞。

			support_seperatist_deficit_trigger = yes
		}

tooltips.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]会铭记这件事。
tooltips.en: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] will remember this.

label.zh: 那我们又能得到什么回报呢？
label.en: What do we get in return?

tooltips.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]会铭记这件事。
tooltips.en: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] will remember this.

label.zh: 如果他们需要帮助，他们应该重新加入我们。
label.en: If they want aid they should rejoin us.

descriptions.zh:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]似乎从周边某个地方收到了经济援助。现在他们已经准备好防范[root.GetFotDAid]危机中可能出现的最坏的影响了。 

由于我们先前的支援，他们决定偿还我们的人情，不求回报地向我们提供帮助。
descriptions.en:
Economic aid seems to have come from a nearby source. [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is ready to stem the worst effects of our current [root.GetFotDAid] crisis. 

Due to our previous support, they have decided to repay the favor, offering us help free of charge.

descriptions.zh:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]似乎从周边某个地方收到了经济援助。现在他们已经准备好防范[root.GetFotDAid]危机中可能出现的最坏的影响了。 

一位沾沾自喜的信使告知我们他们提供帮助的报价是[root.fotdGetTechPrice]。我们有得选吗？
descriptions.en:
Economic aid seems to have come from a nearby source. [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is ready to stem the worst effects of our current [root.GetFotDAid] crisis. 

A smug message informed us that the price for their help would be [root.fotdGetTechPrice]. Do we have a choice?

label.zh: 真是好邻居。
给这帮子[fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]他们想要的。

tooltips.zh: 这会让我们§R10年§!内无法进入§Y虚境§!。
tooltips.en: This will prevent us from accessing §YThe Shroud§! for §R10 years§!.

label.zh: 我们应该独立挺过难关。

options.script: name = origin.6025.c

descriptions.zh:
虽然确认外星人存在的消息对[Root.GetHomeWorldName]来说并非意料之外，但在[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上情况就要糟糕得多。他们本来抱着微不足道的希望生活，祈愿大分裂者的毁灭只是一个古怪的事故，但现在他们确信，宇宙是要来对付他们。

“我们需要在这些外星人来这里完成工作之前消灭他们！”这正是[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]媒体上正在播放的那种疯狂的呼喊。
descriptions.en:
While the news confirming existence of aliens was not entirely unexpected for [Root.GetHomeWorldName], it was felt worse on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They were living with the minuscule hope that perhaps the Divider's destruction was just a freak accident, but now they are convinced that the universe is out to get them.

"We need to destroy these Aliens before they can come here and finish the job!" is the type of frantic cry being broadcast on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] media.

label.zh: 我们生活的星系就是如此。他们很快就会适应的。
label.en: That's the galaxy we live in. They will adapt soon enough.

label.zh: 这是无稽之谈，屏蔽他们的传输信号。
label.en: This is nonsense. Block their transmissions.

descriptions.zh: 发现外星智能生命的消息已经传到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]。然而，出乎我们的预期，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并没有传来恐惧和愤怒的情感，当地反而陷入了沉默。多艘恒星际飞船重新回到了自己的船坞，还有数个旧的超光速驱动器从仓库中挪出。看来他们正准备进行一次远行。
descriptions.en: News of the discovery of intelligent alien life has reached [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. However, instead of the fear and outrage that we expected to from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName], they have instead gone silent. Multiple inter-system ships have returned to their dockyards, and several old FTL drives are missing from storage. It appears they are preparing for an excursion.

label.zh: 我们需要知道正在发生的情况。
label.en: We need to know what's going on.

label.zh: 让他们自个玩去吧。

descriptions.zh:
在我们与[From.GetName]初步展开沟通后，我们收到了一些令人不安的消息：一支由过时的[Root.GetAdj]飞船组成的攻击舰队已经进入[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的宇域，现在正向他们的恒星基地加速前进。这些战舰以这样的加速度前进，想必舰船内部任何[owner_species.GetBiologicalLithoidLower]现在已经变成了[owner_species.GetLiquidState]状态。

幸运的是，我们做好了充分的准备。在观察到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的异常行为后，我们随时都可以在太空中将他们打下来，不让他们击中空间站。
descriptions.en:
After our initial communication with the [From.GetName], we received some troubling news: an attack fleet of outdated [Root.GetAdj] ships has entered [From.GetSpeciesAdj] space, and is now speeding towards their starbase. The accelerating ships are moving at such a rate that anything [owner_species.GetBiologicalLithoidLower] inside them must have been reduced to a [owner_species.GetLiquidState] state by now.

Fortunately, we are prepared. Having observed the odd behavior of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] we stand ready to shoot them out of space before they can hit the station.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = fotd_secured_contact }

descriptions.zh:
在我们与[From.GetName]初步展开沟通后，我们收到了一些令人不安的消息：一支由过时的[Root.GetAdj]飞船组成的攻击舰队已经进入[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的宇域，现在正向他们的恒星基地加速前进。这些战舰以这样的加速度前进，想必舰船内部任何[owner_species.GetBiologicalLithoidLower]现在已经变成了[owner_species.GetLiquidState]状态。

我们没有办法阻止这场灾难。这些超规格的导弹将彻底摧毁[target_system.GetName]的恒星基地。我们只能惊恐地看着。除非……
descriptions.en:
After our initial communication with the [From.GetName], we received some troubling news: an attack fleet of outdated [Root.GetAdj] ships has entered [From.GetSpeciesAdj] space, and is now speeding towards their starbase. The accelerating ships are moving at such a rate that anything [owner_species.GetBiologicalLithoidLower] inside them must have been reduced to a [owner_species.GetLiquidState] state by now.

There is nothing we can do to stop this disaster. These oversized missiles will completely demolish the starbase in [target_system.GetName]. We can only look on in horror. Unless...
descriptions.condition: trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fotd_secured_contact } }

label.zh: 立刻阻止他们！
让他们削弱这些外星人，然后把锅扣在[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上。
label.en: Let them weaken these aliens, then reprimand [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName].

tooltips.zh: §Y[target_system.GetName]§!的恒星基地会被§R摧毁§!。
tooltips.en: The starbase in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! will be §RDestroyed§!.

label.zh: 我们的邻国很虚弱。趁着这个机会结果他们！
label.en: Our neighbors are weak. Use this opportunity to end them!

tooltips.zh:
§Y[target_system.GetName]§!的恒星基地会被§R摧毁§!。
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]将会失去§Y5§!艘位于§Y[target_system.GetName]§!星系的护卫舰的控制权。
将会同§Y[From.GetName]§!进入§R全面战争§!状态。
tooltips.en:
The starbase in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! will be §RDestroyed§!.
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] will cede control of §Y5§! corvettes in §Y[target_system.GetName]§!.
Will enter a §RTotal War§! with §Y[From.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们位于§Y[target_system.GetName]§!的恒星基地被一帮子所谓的[From.GetName]“叛逃分子”给摧毁了。我们已经收到了道歉，对方承诺不会再发生这种情况。但谁知道呢？今天是[target_system.GetName]，也许明天就是[capital_star.GetName]。
descriptions.en: Our starbase in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed by so-called "rogue agents", the [From.GetName]! We have already received an apology and a promise that this will not happen again. But who knows? First it was [target_system.GetName], and perhaps [capital_star.GetName] is next.

label.zh: 密切关注他们的行动。
他们威胁到了我们的存续。不是他们死就是我们亡！
label.en: They threaten our very existence. It's them or us!

descriptions.zh:
在与[From.GetName]第一次接触后不久，我们在§Y[target_system.GetName]§!的恒星基地就被爆炸摧毁。在系统掉线之前，我们接收到了图像，那是一支采用[From.GetAdj]设计的敌方舰队。

我们现在发现自己卷入了一场事关生死存亡的战争之中。
descriptions.en:
Shortly after first contact with the [From.GetName], our starbase in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! exploded. Before the system went dark, we received images of a hostile armada of [From.GetAdj] design.

We now find ourselves engaged in a war for our very survival.

label.zh: 各战斗单位就位！

descriptions.zh:
虽然我们尽了全力设法将他们蒙在鼓里，但没过多久，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]就听说我们成为了[owner.federation.GetName]的成员国一事。这种亲外主义的证据引起了我们伙伴世星球的一些极端反响。一夜之间，许多对我们联邦其他成员国的贬义词和标签涌现出来。

[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]已经因为我们先前的外交行动被激怒，而这一次则让他们彻底翻了脸。在我们切断他们的联系之前，他们设法向我们的盟友发送了几条五颜六色的信息，损害了我们之间的关系，其影响也许是永久性的。
descriptions.en:
While we did our best to keep them in the dark, it did not take long for [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] to hear about our membership in the [owner.federation.GetName]. This evidence of xenophilia has elicited some extreme reactions from our partner world. Derogatory terms and labels for our federation members have sprung up overnight.

[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] was already agitated after our previous diplomatic actions, and this seems to have tipped them over the edge. Before we could cut them off, they managed to send several colorful messages to our allies, damaging our relations, perhaps permanently.

descriptions.zh:
虽然我们尽了全力设法将他们蒙在鼓里，但没过多久，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]就听说我们成为了[owner.federation.GetName]的成员国一事。这种亲外主义的证据引起了我们伙伴世星球的一些极端反响。一夜之间，许多对我们联邦其他成员国的贬义词和标签涌现出来。

公众的愤怒甚至影响到了我们兄弟星球的学术界，他们现在已经结束了我们两颗星球之间的所有合作项目。只能希望我们的新联邦盟友能够理解这一切。
descriptions.en:
While we did our best to keep them in the dark, it did not take long for [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] to hear about our membership in the [owner.federation.GetName]. This evidence of xenophilia has elicited some extreme reactions from our partner world. Derogatory terms and labels for our federation members have sprung up overnight.

The public outrage has even reached the academies of our partner world which have now ended all cooperative projects between our worlds. It is to be hoped that our new federation allies will understand.

label.zh: 我们的盟友会把这个视作无意义的闹剧。肯定的。
label.en: Our allies will see this for the nonsense it is. Surely.

label.zh: 派出特使！

descriptions.zh: 自[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]恒星系传来的消息深深震撼了我们的母星。如果像这样的怪物都能够存在，那么在太空深处还可能潜伏着什么样的威胁？在我们的人民中，要求移民到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的申请已经飙升。然而此时此刻，我们很难责怪他们。
descriptions.en: The news from the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system has shaken our homeworld deeply. What other threats may be lurking in the depths of space, if monsters like this can exist? Already, applications for immigration to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have soared amongst our people. At the moment, it is difficult to blame them.

label.zh: 难道我们错了？

tooltips.zh: §R200§!£pop£§H人口§!会移民前往[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]
tooltips.en: §R200§! £pop£ §HPops§! will emigrate to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]

label.zh: 不！[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]才是错误的！我们必须一起面对这个。
label.en: No! [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is wrong! We will face this together.

descriptions.zh:
当我们向[overlord.GetName]臣服后，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]立马就来讥讽我们。

“任何外星生命本质上都是有敌意的。如果你们当初就留在[home_planet.GetStarName]上，这一切都不会发生！”

不用说，我们的内部人民现在还不是特别团结。
descriptions.en:
After our submission to the [overlord.GetName], [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] did not waste any time ridiculing us.

"Alien life is inherently hostile. If you all had simply stayed in [home_planet.GetStarName], none of this would have happened!"

Needless to say, our people are not particularly unified right now.

label.zh: 通讯终止。

descriptions.zh:
在收取了一个附庸之后，我们的帝国朝着一个宇宙强权又迈进了一步。然而，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]却不以为然。根据他们的说法，我们只是成功地将外星人的威胁拉近了。为了表示抗议，他们已经停止了与我们的所有研究合作。

假以时日，我们一定会证明他们是错的。
descriptions.en:
In taking a vassal, our empire made a major leap forward as a galactic power. However, [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is not impressed. According to them, we have only succeeded in bringing the alien threat closer. In protest, they have ceased all research cooperation with us.

In time, we will certainly prove them wrong.

label.zh: 我们的属民肯定没有在密谋针对我们！
label.en: Our subject surely isn't plotting against us!

descriptions.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]的黎明，我们获得了一个意想不到的盟友：来自[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的同志们终于在一个外交问题上与我们达成一致，恳请我们将外星人扫除掉。令人遗憾的是，一旦战争结束，这样的合作就要告一段落了。
descriptions.en: At the dawn of the [FromFrom.GetName] we have gained an unexpected ally: our comrades from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have finally aligned themselves with us on a diplomatic issue, imploring us to wipe the xenos out. It's a shame that once the war is over their co-operation will end.

label.zh: 我们的船坞需要协助！
指派人手前往我们的舰船。
他们观测到什么和敌人有关的吗？
label.en: Have they observed anything about the enemy?

label.zh: 我们能独自应对。

descriptions.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的住民曾经预言的那一天如今已经到来：随着敌国对我们宣战，星系已经成为一处荒凉、充满敌意的境地。然而，这个故事尚未到结局。我们将挺过这一关。
descriptions.en: The day the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] predicted has arrived: with war declared against us, the galaxy has become an inhospitable and hostile realm. However, this story's ending is not yet written. We will survive this.

label.zh: 各战斗单位就位！

tooltips.zh: §Y5%§!的人口会变得更加排外。
tooltips.en: §Y5%§! of Pops will become more Xenophobic.

descriptions.zh: 我们的人民对于这种通过人为手段提升思想水平的经历还很陌生，因此当听说[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们对我们的新升级持有如此激烈的反对意见之后，普遍感到惊讶。这些人警告说，如果我们再“玷污”自己的身体，所有先前的合作努力都将视作无效。
descriptions.en: Still new to this artificially elevated level of thought, our people were surprised to receive such vehement opposition to our new upgrades from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They warn that if we "defile" our bodies any further, all collaborative efforts will be canceled.

label.zh: 对于在这个星系中存活需要付出怎样的代价，他们的理解太肤浅太单纯了。
label.en: They are too simple to understand what it takes to survive in this galaxy.

options.script: name = origin.6095.a

descriptions.zh:
我们决定彻底地转换到合成体的生命形式，作为结果，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们充分履行了当初的承诺：每条通信途径、每个合作研究站和所有形式的媒体现在都被封锁了。

考虑到我们现在已经发展到了如此地步，问题的关键在于，我们是否还需要他们。
descriptions.en:
As a result of our decision to transition to a fully cybernetic form of life, the people of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have made good on their promise: every avenue of communication, every collaborative research station, and all forms of media are now blocked.

The question is whether or not we still need them, now that we are so much more.

label.zh: 让他们在黑暗中颤抖吧。
label.en: Let them cower in the dark.

descriptions.zh: 第一批合成躯体正从工厂车间滚滚落下，并由其未来的寄居者进行视察。然而，并非每个[Species.GetName]都对这一非凡的发展感到兴奋。[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民已经警告我们，如果我们继续在这条歧路上行进，所有先前的合作努力都将视作无效。
descriptions.en: The first synthetic bodies are rolling off the factory floor and are being inspected by their future inhabitants. However, not every [Species.GetName] is excited about this remarkable development. The inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have warned us that they will cancel all collaborative efforts if we continue down this route.

label.zh: 迈向我们的新形态！

options.script: name = origin.6099.a

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的每一名成员都接受了他们新的、机械合成体的形态。然而，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们则选择留在他们的[fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy]凡胎肉体之中。此外，他们已经兑现了先前的威胁，结束了与我们的所有合作关系。
descriptions.en: Every member of the [Root.GetName] has embraced their new, synthetic forms. However, the population of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has chosen to stay in their [fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy] vessels. Furthermore, they have made good on their threat to end all collaborative efforts with us.

label.zh: 没能看透他们的[fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy]囚牢。
label.en: Unable to see past their [fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy] Prisons.

descriptions.zh: 没有必要等待不可避免的[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]评判了。我们已经充分意识到了他们愤怒的想法。在所有的不和谐之音中，想要停止一切合作关系的声音尤其突出。
descriptions.en: There is no need to wait for the inevitable judgment of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] We are fully aware of their agitated thoughts. Amidst the cacophony, their intention to cease all collaboration is crystal clear.

label.zh: 真是老顽固。

options.script: name = origin.6105.a

descriptions.zh: 我们终于同§H虚境§!内的某个大型实体建立了联系。再一次，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName][GetLamentations]侵扰到了我们；他们正在从我们的网络中断开自己的连接，取消了所有的联合研究行动。
descriptions.en: At last we have secured access to one of the grand entities of the §HShroud§!. Once again, the [GetLamentations] of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] intrude on us; they are disconnecting themselves from our networks, cancelling every joint research operation.

descriptions.zh: 这种个人主义反常不值得我们关注，无法理解我们开明思想的人在我们中也没有立足之地。
descriptions.en: Such individualist deviancy is beneath our concern, those who cannot comprehend our enlightened thoughts have no place among us.

descriptions.zh: 这种没有逻辑的行为无足轻重。我们自己的处理能力已经远超他们原始的理解力。
descriptions.en: Such illogical actions are inconsequential. Our own processing power has ascended beyond their primitive comprehension.

descriptions.zh: 只有我们才明白这样的行为实际上有多么无足轻重。有一种更开明的伙伴关系即将诞生。
descriptions.en: Only we understand how inconsequential such actions truly are. The birth of a more enlightened partnership is at hand.

label.zh: 我们的飞升是大势所趋。

descriptions.zh:
自从我们成功地改造了自己的给养来源，[Root.GetSpeciesName]就幻想着基因强化的无限可能性。现在这一天已经到来。缺陷、弱点、不完美——这些都将成为被抛弃的历史遗留物。

唯一持反对意见的是[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民。他们称这种改造是一次堕落，将不可避免地导致一个由基因完善者统治的阶级主义社会。
descriptions.en:
Ever since we successfully modified our source of sustenance, [Root.GetSpeciesName] have fantasized about the limitless possibilities of genetic enhancement. Now the day has come. Defects, weaknesses, imperfections - these are all remnants of a discarded past.

The only naysayers are the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They have called such modification a slippery slope, one that will inevitably lead to a classist society ruled by the genetically perfected.

label.zh: 允许这些瑕疵继续存在是不负责任的。
label.en: Allowing these flaws to persist would be irresponsible.

options.script: name = origin.6115.a

descriptions.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]拒绝一切形式的通讯。当我们破解了如何将外星基因拼接到我们身体构成中这一秘密以后，他们留给我们的只有一条信息：“你已经放弃了作为[fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpecesName]的意义”。
descriptions.en: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] refuses all communication. Once we cracked the secret of splicing alien genetics into our physical makeup, they left us with a single message: "You have abandoned what it means to be [fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpecesName]"

label.zh: 将思维狭隘的人抛到身后。

descriptions.zh:
当整个宇宙面临威胁时，即使是我们隐居的邻国也必须站出来采取行动。只要我们能够抵抗即将到来的风暴，我们将会再次成为同一个民族。

我们已被授予[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]舰队的指挥权。
descriptions.en:
When the galaxy is threatened even our reclusive neighbors must act. As long as we can resist the coming storm we will be one people again.

We have been granted command of the [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] fleet.

label.zh: 我们拒绝被扼杀。
label.en: We refuse to be snuffed out.

descriptions.zh: 我们的兄弟行星要求我们对他们的一些发现进行确认。他们再次声称有证据表明，§Y大分裂者§!实际上是被某个满怀恶意的外星实体给摧毁的。这已经变得令人厌烦了；每隔几年，他们似乎都会发现一些新的“证据”。
descriptions.en: Our partner planet has requested that we confirm some of their findings. Once again, they claim to have evidence that §YThe Divider§! was destroyed by a malicious foreign entity. This has become tiresome; every few years it seems they discover some new "proof".

label.zh: 让我们逗他们乐乐。

descriptions.zh:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]是对的！

我们多年前所遭受的攻击确实是一个能发射大型钨制弹丸的邪恶实体所为。由于母星系独特的重力场我们才得以幸存。通过分析那个关键夜晚的数据并与这些新的发现进行交叉研究，我们可以定位出这颗小行星大小的钨弹的来源位置。

它来自一个我们在数十年前就已经登记过的格外富矿（但除此之外也没有别的特点）的星系。
descriptions.en:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] were right!

The attack we suffered all those years ago was perpetrated by a malicious entity capable of launching massive tungsten projectiles. Only the unique gravitational features of our home system allowed us to survive. By analyzing the data from that fateful night and cross-referencing it with these new findings, it was possible for us to triangulate the source of the asteroid-sized tungsten round.

It originated from an incredibly mineral-rich (yet otherwise unremarkable) system we have had in our logs for decades.

label.zh: 给我们的超空间驱动器充能。

descriptions.zh:
曾经侵略过我们的势力所在的恒星系现在是一片不毛之地。虽然一个小行星带缺乏矿物并不罕见，但这个小行星带可以说是已经被剥光了。不仅如此，在应该有富含稀有金属的小行星的地方，我们只发现了灰尘。不管居住在这个恒星系的物种是如何获取他们用于制造子弹的钨的，他们现在已经没有这样的资源了。他们似乎甚至没有能力离开他们的行星。

虽然他们已经尽力保持隐蔽，阻断了所有的无线电信号，甚至限制使用人工照明，但我们还是在该恒星系唯一的宜居行星上探测到了生命。
descriptions.en:
The system of our old aggressors is barren. While it isn't unusual for an asteroid belt to be mineral-poor, this one has been stripped bare. Not only that, but where there should be minor planetoids rich in rare metals, we have found only dust. However the species inhabiting this system managed to gain the tungsten necessary to construct their bullets, they no longer have the resources to do so now. They don't even seem to be capable of leaving their planet.

While they have done their best to remain hidden, preventing all radio signals and even limiting the use of artificial lights, we have detected life on the system's lone habitable planet.

label.zh: 让我们好好拜访一下旧日的梦魇。
label.en: Let's pay our old nightmares a visit.

descriptions.zh: 观察§Y菲沃尔人§!的经历对于我们来说相当有启发性。事实上，他们的意识形态与导致我们自己物种分裂的意识形态非常相似。然而，菲沃尔人没有选择自我隔离，而是选择了对他们能够探测到的任何生命迹象进行先制打击的策略。一旦他们耗尽了重金属，这些外星人就只能回到他们的星球，从他们现在贫瘠的家园中拾掇一切来勉强维持生计。虽然我们伙伴星球的领导层正在敦促我们采取与菲沃尔人相同的策略，但如何最好地对付我们的潜在灭绝者，这事并没有我们原以为的那么简单。
descriptions.en: Observing the §YFevorians§! has been a revelatory experience. In fact, their ideology is remarkably similar to that which produced the split in our own species. However, rather than choosing isolation, the Fevorians opted for a strategy of pre-emptive strikes against any life signs they could detect. Once they ran out of heavy metals, the aliens returned to their world, scraping whatever bare subsistence they could from their now barren home. While the leadership of our partner planet is urging us to adopt the same tactics as the Fevorians, how best to deal with our would-be exterminators is no easy question.

label.zh: 宇宙中只剩下我们才是安全的。
label.en: We will only be safe when we are alone.

tooltips.zh: 我们会加入我们的兄弟行星，为确保星系的安全将其他生命全部抹除。就从这块石头开始。
tooltips.en: We will join our partner planet in securing this galaxy by expunging all other life. Starting with this rock here.

label.zh: 我们会向他们表示同情。

tooltips.zh: 衷心希望，他们能够从我们身上学会，不是所有的外星人都要杀个干净。
tooltips.en: Hopefully, they can learn from us that not all alien life is out to kill them.

descriptions.zh: 毁灭菲沃尔人竟是……这么容易？又少了一个威胁到我们生存的猎人。我们已经很久没有感觉到与我们的伙伴星球如此同步了。也许他们是对的。这里只有两种类型的生命：静默的和死亡的。
descriptions.en: Destroying the Fevorians was... easy? One fewer hunter, threatening our existence. We have not felt this in sync with our partner world for a long time. Perhaps they were right. There are only two types of life out here: the silent and the dead.

label.zh: 我们应当将他们全部静默。
不，我们不会成为侵略者。
label.en: No, we will not be the aggressors.

descriptions.zh:
§Y菲沃尔卫星§!比我们最初预期的要更重要。整个星系里仅存的重金属原来全部都在这颗卫星内，进一步研究发现这颗卫星其实是一座巨型的质量投射器。错综复杂的投射机构往返盘绕着整颗小行星。粗略计算表明，这个武器可以将在和发射至高亚光速。

最后次发射的数据仍停留在其火控计算机中，目标就是[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。
descriptions.en:
The §YFevorian Moon§! was more important than we first anticipated. The only heavy metals left in the system are found within the moon, which upon closer examination was revealed to be a titanic mass driver. The sprawling launch mechanism encircles the planetoid multiple times. Rough calculations indicate that the weapon could launch payloads approaching the speed of light.

The data for the final shot is still in its targeting computer, aimed at [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

label.zh: 我们必须返回家园！

descriptions.zh:
§Y菲沃尔人§!赢了。我们的人口九死一生，家园支离破碎。

直到这颗行星的最后一刻，跨大气层运输船还在将[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断运往轨道。而来不及离开的人则在高亚光速炮弹击中的瞬间被产生的高温瞬间化为灰烬。[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]愿意接纳我们的政府并安置难民。
descriptions.en:
The §YFevorians§! have won. Our people are decimated, and our home world desecrated.

Inter-atmosphere ships were ferrying [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] into orbit until the planet's final moments. Those who remained on the surface were incinerated the instant the near-lightspeed projectile ignited the atmosphere. [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has offered to host our government and house the evacuees.

label.zh: 骇人听闻。

options.script: name = DEVASTATING

descriptions.zh: [Target.GetName]已经恢复安全了。我们已经成功将钨弹偏转到了足够远的地方，以确保我们自己能够存活下来。尽管经过其漫长的旅途之后，它很可能成为另一个行星的问题。
descriptions.en: [Target.GetName] is safe. We have managed to divert the tungsten projectile far enough to ensure our own survival, though over the course of its long journey, it may very well become another planet's problem.

label.zh: 现在，该看看卫星了。

descriptions.zh: 我们的科学家孜孜不倦地针对“§Y菲沃尔问题§!”进行攻关，目前已经提出了四种截然不同的解决方案。如果我们迅速应对，他们相信我们有相当的机会对这个恐怖事物进行偏转。
descriptions.en: Our scientists have been working tirelessly on the "§YFevorian Problem§!" and have come up with four distinct solutions. If we act quickly, they believe we have a fair chance to deflect this terror.

label.zh: 看着它完成！

descriptions.zh:
由于[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]组织的抗议活动在[From.GetAdj]大使馆的正门前发生了骚乱，本应是对多样性和友谊进行庆祝的庆典活动，最后却在酸楚中结束。抗议者并不羞于表达自己的观点，他们喊出了“[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]滚回垃圾站！”这样丰富多彩的口号。

毫不意外的是，这次事件俨然成为了两国之间外交关系紧张的导火索。
descriptions.en:
What should have been a celebration of diversity and friendship ended on a sour note as a protest organized by [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] broke out in front of the [From.GetAdj] embassy. The protestors were not shy about their views, shouting such colorful slogans as "[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] belong in the recycling plant!"

Unsurprisingly, this has increased diplomatic tensions between our empires.

label.zh: 立刻谴责[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并进行道歉。
让他们叫唤。

descriptions.zh:
[FromFrom.GetName]战争将会被永远铭记，在这一刻我们与[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并肩作战，携手抗击外来威胁。

面对这一最新的威胁，我们本以为会从[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们那收到嘲笑的信息。但他们的回复却是这样的：

“有哪里需要帮助吗？”
descriptions.en:
[FromFrom.GetName] war will forever be remembered as the moment that we and [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] stood together, unified against an existential threat.

Confronted by this latest terror, we expected another dismissive message from the people of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. Instead, they responded with five words: 

"Where do you need us?"

label.zh: 我们需要建造更多的舰船！
label.en: We need to build more ships!

label.zh: 我们的舰队需要更多的军官！
label.en: We need more officers in our fleets!

label.zh: 把我们敌人的所有一切都告诉我们。
label.en: Tell us everything about our enemy.

label.zh: 我们可以独自应付。

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不适应[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上的条件。但得益于细致的环境改造，严苛的环境终将成为历史。

尽管[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]还残留着一些更加困难的环境，但这颗星球的居住者们已经让[From.Target.GetClassAdj]环境彻底成了历史。
descriptions.en:
Conditions on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have always been inhospitable to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But thanks to diligent terraforming, extreme hardship will become a thing of the past.

While [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] remains a somewhat challenging environment, the inhabitants of the world have left their [From.Target.GetClassAdj] past behind.

label.zh: 希望他们喜欢这些改变。

descriptions.zh:
他们完成了。

我们有些人之前说，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民简直是疯了才会在那种鬼地方定居。而如今，他们已经将那里改造成了第二个[home_planet.GetName]，吸引着每一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
descriptions.en:
They have done it.

Some of our people called the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] mad for settling a world with such horrendous conditions. Yet, now they have fashioned a more than adequate facsimile of [home_planet.GetName], attractive to any [Root.GetSpeciesName].

label.zh: 似乎我们的星球已经不是唯一在[from.Target.GetStarName]有吸引力的地方了。
label.en: It seems ours is not the only attractive world in [from.Target.GetStarName] anymore.

descriptions.zh: 也许是受我们自己在环境改造方面所取得成功的启发，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民已经将他们的星球塑造成了一件真正的美丽之物。之前就很丰饶的[From.Target.GetClassName]现在已经成为一个盖亚星球。居民们可以继续在天堂里躲避宇宙的威胁。
descriptions.en: Perhaps inspired by our own successes in terraforming, the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have sculpted their world into a thing of true beauty. The previously bountiful [From.Target.GetClassName] has become a Gaia World. The inhabitants can continue to hide from the galaxy in paradise.

descriptions.zh: 来自[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的消息令人惭愧：当地居民已经突破了[home_planet.GetName]的发展界限。他们摒弃了[From.GetClassName]的形态，成功打造出一颗盖亚星球。面对近在咫尺的理想家园，我们的民众开始质疑：为何还要继续留在这里生活？
descriptions.en: Humiliating news from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]: the inhabitants have managed to transcend the limits of [home_planet.GetName]. By discarding the form of a [From.GetClassName], they have created a Gaia World. Many of our own people question why they should continue to live here, when a paradise exists on their doorstep.

label.zh: 想要改善自己的家园，这是非常自然的想法。
label.en: It's only natural to want to improve one's home.

descriptions.zh: 最近的报告称[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]已经部署了一支巡逻舰队，用以保卫[capital_star.GetName]。他们好像已经发展出了隐形科技。好在他们已经同意把频率分享给我们。
descriptions.en: Recent reports indicate that [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has now deployed a fleet to patrol [capital_star.GetName]. They appear to have developed cloaking technology. Thankfully, they have agreed to share their frequencies with us.

label.zh: 了解。

descriptions.zh:
观察者们，你们好。据说我们的祖先曾试图消灭你们。

为此，我们表示歉意。坦率地说，我们很惊讶你们没有进行报复。

从那时起已经过去了许多个世纪，我们愿意相信，我们现在是一个不一样的民族了，毋庸置疑这也要感谢你们。

我们想再给宇宙一次机会。能允许我们和你们一起探索吗？
descriptions.en:
Greetings Observers. It is said that our ancestors tried to end you.

For that, we apologize. Frankly, we are surprised that you didn't return the favor.

Many centuries have past since then, and we would like to believe that we are a different people now, no doubt thanks to you as well.

We wish to give the universe a second chance. Would you allow us to explore it with you?

label.zh: 可以。
你们可以按自己的意愿行事。
label.en: You are free to do so on your own.

tooltips.zh: 我们要返回菲沃尔母星系。
tooltips.en: We shall return the Fevorian home system.

label.zh: 管好你自己。

tooltips.zh: 我们要停止启蒙菲沃尔人。
tooltips.en: We will stop enlightening the Fevorians.
